decisions: Upgraded installs (installed, no disclosed_at) are treated as not disclosed and asked once, per the issue's item 4; they are never counted as new installs.

An unreadable or unparsable state file is read as installed and not disclosed: it asks again, sends nothing before the answer and never re-sends app_installed; its notice uses the 'may already have sent' line (sent_before true) because nothing can be assumed about the past.
Answering off clears what waits and the held start; a later switch on (About) sends from that moment, and app_installed then goes at the next start (the person chose on).
Accounts and days seen before the answer are counted locally only (known updated, active_day not marked), so nothing from before the answer is reported after it, matching the task's rule.

The question sits above every page but About (About asks the same in its panel); it is not modal and does not take focus when it appears; the five-step tour waits for it and for the status read, so one first-run card shows at a time.
An older or unreadable status (no disclosed field, read failure) shows no question; the backend still sends nothing until answered.
disclosed is an atomic beside state.disclosed_at so the state lock is never taken twice; a start racing the answer is resolved under the held slot (lock order held, then state).
